storm.title: Storm Damage Roofing and Insurance Claim Help
storm.intro: Most homeowners insurance policies cover sudden, storm-related roof damage. We inspect your roof for free, meet your adjuster and handle the roofing side of your claim, from the first photo to the final shingle.
items: search
Free storm-damage inspection
We inspect your roof, gutters and attic for obvious and hidden damage, and tell you honestly whether it looks cosmetic or claim-worthy.
book
Photo documentation
We photograph everything, and bring the roofing facts, photos and a detailed estimate to your claim.
users
We meet your adjuster
A Panda representative can be on the roof with the adjuster, pointing out the damage slope by slope, so nothing gets overlooked.
roof
Your new roof, installed
Once the claim is approved, the insurance scope is our baseline. If tear-off uncovers hidden damage, we help submit a supplement for the extra work.
storm.note: Your roofing advocate, not a public adjuster. You stay in control of your claim and talk to your insurance company; your insurance company decides what is covered.
link: More about storm damage and insurance claims

process.title: How a Panda Roof Replacement Works
items: Free inspection
Fill in the form or call us. We inspect your roof, gutters and attic, photograph everything and tell you honestly what we find.
Insurance claim or quote
If storm damage is behind your new roof, we meet your adjuster and help you through the claim. If not, you get a clear quote at no cost, and we go over flexible financing with you.
Installation
Our certified crew schedules your project. Most homes have a new roof in as little as one day; the exact timing depends on the size of your roof, the material and the weather.
Warranty and final walkthrough

Friendly customer service from your estimate to the final walkthrough. Your project is then backed by our 100% satisfaction guarantee, a two-year installation warranty and the manufacturers’ warranties.

warranty.title: Roof Warranties: GAF Coverage and Panda Workmanship
warranty.intro: Every project, from roofing to gutters, is backed by our 100% satisfaction guarantee, our installation warranty and the manufacturers’ warranties on the products we install.
items: shield
100% satisfaction guarantee
Every remodeling project is covered by our guarantee, so you can rest easy knowing your renovation will meet the highest standards.
badge
Two-year installation warranty
If our workmanship proves faulty within two years of installation, we’ll correct it at no cost to you. Some products have a longer installation warranty.
layers
GAF manufacturer warranties
As a GAF Master Elite contractor, a status held by less than 2% of roofing companies, we can offer GAF’s upgraded warranties, like the Golden Pledge, available only through Master Elite contractors.

faq.title: Roof Replacement Questions, Answered
items: How much does a new roof cost?

Every roof is different. The price depends on the size and pitch of your roof, the material you choose, the condition of the decking underneath and the code items it needs. We’ll inspect your roof and give you a free, no-obligation estimate.
Will my insurance pay for a new roof?

Often, when the damage is sudden and storm-related: wind, hail, falling limbs or the weight of snow and ice. Old age and wear and tear usually aren’t covered. Your deductible and your type of coverage affect what you pay.
How long does a roof replacement take?

Our dedicated roofing contractors prioritize one-day roof replacements, so most homes have a new roof in as little as one day. The exact timing depends on the size of your roof, the material and the weather.
Can I finance my new roof?
Yes. Spread the cost with flexible financing through Service Finance, LLC. Homeowners may qualify for delayed payments and even no-interest loans.
How long is the installation warranty?
Two years after the products are installed, and longer for some products. Your contract has the precise length for each one.
Which areas does Panda Exteriors serve?
Panda Exteriors works across the East Coast from local offices in Maryland, Delaware, Florida, New Jersey, North Carolina, Pennsylvania and Virginia.
Is your company licensed?
Yes, we are fully licensed and insured.
When is it time to replace my roof?
The typical roof lasts about 15 years. It's essential to consider replacing your roof if it has sustained any storm damage or as it approaches its expected lifespan.
